sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – proposal for 2027 onwards
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for taking the time to review our requirements. We would very much like to continue working with Werdenfels and appreciate your team's consideration of a longer-term arrangement.

Would you kindly consider EUR 4.60/kg for part:370010, with payment within 14 days net and a 36-month contract? We propose AS-14404 on a 45% material share, with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. Our annual requirement is 23,700 kg, with DAP delivery, a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges.

For context, our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

We recognize the cost pressures you described. We hope that prompt payment, a longer commitment and the proposed adjustment mechanism provide a useful basis for reviewing the starting price together. If a 24-month commitment would suit your team better, we would be pleased to discuss that as well.

Thank you again for considering the package. Could you kindly let us know what binding offer you can approve?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed the historical purchase orders you cited and acknowledge the price development. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. 

For our main Angebot, we are pleased to propose a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We are agreeable to the AS-14404 index clause and the 14-day payment terms, but we prefer to fix the contract duration at 24 months as you kindly offered. Under this revised 24-month package, we can offer a unit price of EUR 5.40 per kg. Alternatively, with a contract term of 24 months: €5.40 per unit.

For your reference, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Furthermore, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – revised proposal on your preferred 24-month term
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you very much for your revised offer and for taking the time to review the order history we shared. We appreciate your agreement to the AS-14404 clause and the 14-day payment terms, and we are glad to move to the 24-month term you preferred.

On that basis, would you kindly consider EUR 4.72/kg for part:370010, with payment within 14 days net, a 24-month contract and AS-14404 on a 45% material share, with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08? All other terms remain as in our enquiry: 23,700 kg per year, DAP delivery, a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges.

With the material share now following AS-14404, we hope there is room to review the base price further. If any specific element of the package makes this difficult for your team, we would be grateful to hear about it so that we can look at it together.

Thank you again for your constructive response.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised proposal and for confirming the 24-month contract term. It is always a pleasure working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we remain dedicated to supporting your operations with our strong service and broad range.

While the index clause addresses the material share, the base price must sustainably cover our processing and operational costs. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We present our Angebot at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. For your reference, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: part:370010 – revised proposal, 24-month package with AS-14404
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your further move to EUR 5.30/kg and for explaining that the base price must sustainably cover your processing and operational costs. We fully understand that concern and appreciate your team's continued effort.

To move closer together, would you kindly consider EUR 4.83/kg for part:370010, with payment within 14 days net, a 24-month contract and AS-14404 on a 45% material share, with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08? All other terms remain as in our enquiry: 23,700 kg per year, DAP delivery, a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges.

It would also help us to understand the processing side better. Could you kindly clarify which part of the annual increases you mentioned is already reflected in the prices applied to our existing orders and which remains outstanding? Our June and September orders were at different prices, EUR 5.26/kg and EUR 5.84/kg, although those records do not tell us which costs the change covered.

Thank you again for your patience and constructive approach.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We are withdrawing from this negotiation. Please be aware that our general Angebot stays valid for 14 days. 

We always strive to support you with our extensive product range and high service standards, and we hope to work together again on future opportunities.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
